about: Performance budgets checked by scripts/perf.mjs (npm run perf) and the Performance workflow. Counts are exact and fail CI when exceeded. Timings come from a shared CI machine with a software GPU, so they're loose and only catch big regressions. Raise a number only on purpose, in the same commit as the change that needs it, and say why (docs/PERFORMANCE.md). Measured 2026-11-23 at 80de318: 0 things 10 draws; 400 things 132 draws; 2000 things 315 draws, 149 for things, 95 touched a frame (the flags), 0.4 ms main thread, 6 ms worker tick; main bundle 309 KB gzip. Glows instanced (2026-11-23): 400 things 98 draws; 2000 things 163 draws, 153 for things and glows.
